prose: What reckons the "Acceptable Year of the Lord?" In this 13th episode of Inner Whirled, Dylan and I are again joined by Crrow777, as we go beyond the obvious zodiacal significance of the 12 apostles and consider the Old Testament patriarchs of Israel's dozen tribes. We also look at the fascinating solar footage Crrow and others have filmed of a strange second sun. Members will enjoy a solid three and a half hour examination as we continue to honor the work of the renegade Reverend Robert Taylor.
